decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 07-10-103/PD - 300, 07-10-103/100, 07-10-103/PD - 105 and 07-10-103/PD -104 submitted 29 November 2010 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The garage shown on drawing No. 07-10-103/PD shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.
description: Erection of a single storey rear and side extension with roof lights
